title.narrative: 3.2. Number of research and policy documents regarding the implementation and expansion of the tax exemption policy to support Indonesian CSOs**

description.narrative: Tax exemption facilities for research funding is mandated by Government Regulation 45/2019 concerning Changes in the Calculation of Taxable Income and Income Tax Repayment in the Current Year where the regulation stipulates that for domestic corporate taxpayers a gross income reduction of up to 300% of the total costs incurred for certain research and development activities in Indonesia is given and charged within a certain period. This regulation is not widely understood by the private sector and is still limited to support for research and development, not including for example the cost of community empowerment, provision of working capital for small and medium enterprises, etc

comment.narrative: In semester 2. 1 desk research and a set of policy documents regarding the implementation and expansion of the tax exemption policy are produced
